messages:
Anna G: Quick ask — we need a lightweight benchmark "one-card" for the Apr 10 webinar. Single-slide hero + social square + 1200x300 banner. Focus: latency vs cost sparkline, 2 model callouts (open & redwood-verified), and 3 bullet takeaways. Can design deliver Figma comps by EOD Tuesday? :pray:

Leo D: ok can do a quick pass. Do we have final copy for the 3 bullets? also need the sparkline data (csv or numbers).

Anna G: copy in-thread — 1) Predictable latency at scale, 2) 2–3x cost savings with caching/batching, 3) Unified API across hosted/dedicated/private. Sparkline: please use these token-cost pairs: [1000: $0.10, 5000: $0.42, 20000: $1.60, 50000: $3.40] — show cost per 1k tokens.

Leo D: perfect. will mock color/typography per brand. quick Q: use primary blue or the new teal accent for the sparkline?

Maya (Brand): Use primary blue for headline and teal for the sparkline. Follow the brand safe-zone (16px padding) and use Inter for UI, GT-Alpina for the headline. No rounded corners on the hero card — stick to the container style from the benchmark kit. Please run contrast check.

Sam (Design-ops): tagging checklist: 1) Provide Figma link, 2) export PNGs at 3x for social, 3) include an editable CSV of the sparkline data, 4) attach alt text and 1-line description for accessibility, 5) add source/footnote for cost calc. We need final assets in marketing-assets > webinar/benchmark by Wed 9AM PT.

Leo D: copying checklist. will upload Figma file as: figma.com/file/abcd1234/benchmark-onecard (WIP). For exports: social square 1200x1200 @3x, hero slide 1920x1080 @1x, banner 1200x300 @2x. Alt text draft: “Benchmark: latency vs cost per 1k tokens for Redwood inference.”

Raj (Webinar): Also include a small CTA badge: "See the full benchmark" with link to landing page. Can that be an overlay in the lower-right on the hero?

Leo D: yes — will design with unobtrusive CTA, 48px min tap target.

Maya (Brand): Quick brand check: CTA color should be teal-600 (#00A9A5) with white text, border radius 6px. Use the approved badge icon (assets/icons/benchmark-badge.svg).

Anna G: FYI — localization: we need French and German versions for paid social. l10n-bot will ping when source copy is frozen.

l10n-bot: Reminder queued — freeze source copy by Tue 6PM PT to hit localization SLAs. Link: internal.doc/benchmark-copy-v2

Leo D: noting freeze. I'll upload Figma comps by Tue 5:30PM PT, then hand off for localization and export. If anyone sees anything blocking, flag here. :thumbsup:

Anna G: thanks team — big help. If design-ops can confirm export folder & naming convention after upload that'd be great.

Sam (Design-ops): after upload I'll create marketing-assets/webinar/1934567890/ with files: hero_1920x1080.png, social_1200x1200.png, banner_1200x300.png, sparkline_data.csv, alt_texts.md, figma-link.txt. Will ping when done.
